privacy_meta: How Van Erp Insights handles your personal data.
privacy_intro: Van Erp Insights (Dutch Chamber of Commerce no. {{kvk_number}}), owned by Wim van Erp, handles your personal data with care. This statement explains which data I process, why, and what your rights are. Questions? Email {{email}}.
privacy_contact:
When you get in touch

If you email or call me, I process the details you share yourself: your name, email address, phone number and the content of your message. I use them only to answer your question and, if we work together, to carry out and invoice the assignment.
privacy_booking:
Booking an introductory call

If you book a call through the button on this website, you use the appointment scheduler of {{booking_service}}. You enter your name and email address and choose a time. I use those details only to schedule and prepare the meeting.
privacy_site:
This website

This website does not set cookies. Fonts and images are served from the site's own server; no data is sent to Google Fonts or other third parties. The site is hosted by Netlify. Like any web server, Netlify keeps technical log files (such as IP address and browser type) to keep the site secure and available. Netlify is a US company; any transfer of data outside the EU is based on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses. The LinkedIn link only sends data to LinkedIn when you click it.
privacy_analytics_on:
Visitor statistics

To see how many people visit the site, I use Plausible Analytics. Plausible uses no cookies, does not store IP addresses and runs on servers in the EU. The statistics cannot be traced back to you personally.
privacy_analytics_off:
Visitor statistics

This website does not collect visitor statistics.
privacy_retention:
How long I keep data

I keep messages and contact details no longer than necessary: as a rule, up to two years after our last contact. Data related to assignments and invoicing is kept for seven years, as required by Dutch tax law.

I never sell your data and only share it with parties needed to provide my services, such as my hosting and email provider.
privacy_rights:
Your rights

You may access, correct or delete your data, and you can object to its use. Email {{email}} and you will receive a reply within one month. If you disagree with how your data is handled, you can file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
privacy_changes:
Changes

This statement may be updated when the website or my way of working changes. The date at the top shows when it was last updated.
